initialize.result.successSubtitle: This entry does not include a returnUrl, so the app will not redirect automatically. Continue with the guide below.
initialize.result.initializedSubtitle: This entry does not include a returnUrl, so the app cannot jump back automatically. Continue with the guide below.
initialize.result.guideDescription: Open the management console first to finish setup. The site home entry always uses the current site root path / .
initialize.result.successStep1: Sign in with the administrator email and password you just configured.
initialize.result.successStep2: Finish the remaining site settings, permissions, and content configuration in the console.
initialize.result.successStep3: Verify that the current site root path / is reachable before switching traffic.
initialize.result.initializedStep1: Sign in with an existing administrator account to continue.
initialize.result.initializedStep2: If you really need to re-initialize, confirm the current data status with an administrator first.
initialize.result.initializedStep3: If you only need to inspect the front site, open the current site root path / directly.
